changes: Wanted queue/download badges reconcile against the live download snapshot; stale persisted QUEUED/GRABBED states no longer claim an item is queued after the live job disappears.
Cross-runtime grab reservations display QUEUEING rather than QUEUED until the live download engine exposes a real job.
Continuous Automation reports current phase/target progress and Next Cycle shows In progress while a worker is active.
Bulk metadata refresh and library reconciliation run on their background workers instead of blocking the release-search critical path.

Automatic NZB retrieval uses a bounded 45-second per-release wall budget with individual automatic requests capped at 15 seconds; manual Interactive Search/Grab retains the existing generous request behavior.
Long-running Automation cycles merge newer concurrent failure/blacklist and maintenance runtime state before persisting their final snapshot.
regression_guards: Live download-manager state remains authoritative and overrides persisted Wanted target display state.
A 75-second handoff grace preserves legitimate just-queued jobs before a persisted queue marker is considered stale.
Season-pack member reservation continues to prevent pack/episode overlap.
Library scans and metadata refreshes still run automatically when due; they are decoupled only from the release-search critical path.
v3.6.14 Windows-safe Automation JSON persistence and responsive Save acknowledgements remain preserved.
v3.6.13 verified Remove/Cancel, hidden-transfer reconciliation, Active-card continuity, Wanted policy clarity, and fallback-only season packs remain preserved.
name: Wanted State Reconciliation & Responsive Automation
